title: 4.16 Review: a family at home
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Review every A1+ Unit 4 step with a new family at home: upstairs, on and off, behind, there are, the he/she routine and and then, the past with -ed, Did…?, didn't, it after a verb, how often, a birthday date, last week and some and any, with no new language.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.16 Unit 4 Review: A1 reviews Unit 4 with fresh scenes; A1+ 4.16 reviews every A1+ Unit 4 step with eleven fresh Flash photos of a new family (grandparents, parents, a girl, a boy and their dog) and no new language: Where's the grandfather? He's upstairs. (4.1), the lamp is on (4.2), behind the chair (4.3), Are there two children in the garden? (4.4), she brushes her teeth and then she gets dressed (4.5-4.6), he cleaned the table yesterday (4.7), Did he wash the car? Yes, he did. (4.8), he didn't work on Sunday (4.9), he gives it to his grandmother (4.11), every weekend (4.12), her birthday is on May fourth (4.13), last week (4.14) and some cups (4.15). 4.10's clock times stay in 4.10. Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers; how often, a date and a time of the past are said, never read from a picture.
speaking_outcome: Say where a new family is and what they do, did and did not do, how often, when a birthday is, and what there is, with every Unit 4 form, at a natural pace.
